title: Infinitary logic: infinite expressions and compactness boundaries
proposed_reference_coverage: **Infinitary logic: infinite expressions and compactness boundaries**
fact_or_context_to_reference: The local infinite-conjunction counterexample shows why ordinary propositional compactness needs finite formulas. A broader treatment should define its allowed infinitary syntax and distinguish the compactness principles for it.

coverage_plan.integration_boundary: The current counterexample is already proved locally; distinguish its enlarged syntax from the finite-formula theorem.
